description: This Kotlin source file defines an abstract fragment class `BrandedFragment` that provides branding capabilities such as applying brand-specific colors, customizing UI elements, and lifecycle-based theme adjustments for Android app UI components.

classes.name: BrandedFragment
classes.description: An abstract class extending Fragment that provides branding support, specifically managing and applying brand colors and styling to UI components. It offers lifecycle-aware methods for theme application and custom menu icon tinting.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets edge-to-edge padding for the activity if it is an AppCompatActivity, then calls the superclass onCreate.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Resolves theme attributes for colorAccent and colorPrimary, reads the main brand color via BrandingUtil, and applies it.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Overrides menu creation to tint toolbar icons using branding utilities.

methods.name: lifecycleScopeIOJob
methods.description: Launches a coroutine on the IO dispatcher within the lifecycle scope to perform long-running background tasks.

methods.name: onMainThread
methods.description: Executes a provided block of code on the main (UI) thread if the activity is present.
